title: Avoid spurious final containment ACK refusal when an owned Stop commits queue changes
outcome: A legitimate concurrently executing containment Stop does not spuriously invalidate the final durability image while original obligations remain excluded.
acceptance: A deterministic interleaving covers a Stop queue commit between final containment image capture and durability comparison.
Final acknowledgement either confirms the intended durable state or returns a precise supported refusal without weakening original obligation exclusion.
